slides.title:

It's Why We're No.1.
slides.body: Wild-caught cod, flake, dory, snapper and Tassie salmon, beer-battered, grilled or crumbed, with gluten-free batter on request. Walk up, order online, eat on the sand.

Hot Off The Grill.
